chunks: Al-Saffar from Mu'awiya ibn Hakim from Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Ribat from Mansur ibn Hazim from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

I asked him about a man who had sexual intercourse with a woman, does he marry her daughter? He said, 'If it was a kiss or similar to it, there is no harm, and if it was full intercourse (zina), then no.'

key_terms.فَجَرَ: To have sexual intercourse or commit fornication

ai.seo_question: Can a man marry his daughter if he had sexual relations with her mother?
ai.summary: In this ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), the distinction between *kiss or similar* (minor sexual contact) and *zina* (full intercourse) determines the permissibility of marriage to the daughter, reflecting the principle that minor acts do not create the same prohibitive affinity as full consummation. This hadith is cited in *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* to clarify the degrees of sexual violation and their specific legal consequences on family ties, a key topic in Shia jurisprudence regarding *mahram* relationships.
